video.title: WING IT! - Blender Open Movie
video.description:
WING IT! is an open movie, made entirely with Blender. Get the production files, assets and exclusive making-of videos by joining Blender Studio at https://studio.blender.org/wing-it

--

An uptight engineer gets an unwelcome visit from a enthusiastic wannabe-pilot, causing both of them to be launched into the air inside an out-of-control space shuttle.

Blender Studio is the creative part of the Blender. A dedicated team of artists and developers challenge themselves with creative-technical targets to help Blender users and to drive Blender development forward. This happens in an open source production environment and by sharing everything they make in an open and free license.

Want to know more? Join the studio today and help the team to create & share. https://studio.blender.org/

analysis.summary: An uptight cat engineer preparing a spacecraft for launch is interrupted by an enthusiastic brown dog who hijacks the controls, leading to a chaotic and comedic flight through the sky before crashing back into the barn they started in.

story.premise: A professional cat engineer's meticulous pre-flight checks are ruined by a clumsy but eager canine visitor who takes control of their experimental aircraft.
arc: Cat engineer meticulously prepares the spacecraft while checking off items on a clipboard.
Brown dog enters unexpectedly and excitedly presses buttons, causing mechanical chaos.
The vehicle launches uncontrollably from the barn into the sky with both characters inside.
Zero gravity ensues as the duo struggles to regain control amidst panic.
The ship deploys makeshift wings and flies erratically through the air.
The pilot pulls levers recklessly, causing the craft to plummet from the sky.
The shuttle crashes through the barn roof, landing safely in hay among startled chickens.
Behind-the-scenes footage reveals the Blender animation process used to create the short.

characters.appearance: Grey fur, large blue eyes, pink nose, wearing a blue flight suit with red cuffs and goggles.
characters.role: Protagonist/Engineer trying to prepare for a flight.

characters.appearance: Brown fur, long floppy ears (sometimes appearing blue due to lighting/suit details), wearing an orange spacesuit with blue gloves and a blue headpiece/hat.

audio.music: Upbeat, playful cartoon music that shifts between frantic orchestral comedy and triumphant tones; includes live recording strings.
audio.sound_effects: Clanking metal, scribbling, knocking, mechanical whirring, button beeps, engine roars, explosions, wind rushing, crash sounds, and cartoonish screams.

chapters.title: Cat Engineer Builds a Plane
chapters.summary: A cat engineer works on a plane in a workshop, then exits a barn wearing an orange spacesuit. The scene shifts to show a rough sketch of the aircraft.

chapters.title: Cat Engineer and Dog Visitor Chaos
chapters.summary: A grey cat engineer in a blue flight suit meticulously checks off items on a clipboard inside a spacecraft cockpit. A brown dog with blue ears suddenly appears at the door window, startling the cat. The dog enters, takes the pilot's seat, and excitedly presses buttons, causing the vehicle to shake and various mechanical appendages to activate outside.

chapters.title: Engineer and Pilot Launch Chaos
chapters.summary: A grey cat in a blue pilot suit navigates a chaotic spaceship cockpit, encountering a brown dog in an orange spacesuit. The dog enthusiastically interacts with the controls, leading to a frantic sequence where both characters are tossed around as the ship launches uncontrollably from a barn into the sky.

chapters.title: Chaos in the Cockpit of a Rocket
chapters.summary: A rocket launches into space with two characters inside. The dog, wearing an orange spacesuit, and the cat, in a blue flight suit, experience zero gravity and panic as they lose control. A chicken appears outside, adding to the chaos.

chapters.title: Dog Pilots Out-of-Control Airship
chapters.summary: A dog in an orange flight suit struggles to control a chaotic airship while a cat looks on in horror; the vehicle deploys makeshift wings and flies erratically through the sky.

chapters.title: Shuttle Crash Lands in Barn
chapters.summary: An engineer and a wannabe pilot are inside a damaged space shuttle; the enthusiastic pilot pulls levers, causing the craft to plummet from the sky. The shuttle crashes through the roof of a barn, landing amidst hay and startling chickens.

chapters.title: Behind the Scenes of WING IT!
chapters.summary: The video begins with a chaotic scene inside a barn where an orange dog and a blue cat are amidst debris from a crashed vehicle. The scene transitions to 'The End' text, followed by various behind-the-scenes clips showing the animation process in Blender software, including storyboarding, character rigging, and 3D modeling.

chapters.title: Blender Studio Credits and Behind-the-Scenes
chapters.summary: The video displays the end credits for a Blender open movie titled 'WING IT!'. It features behind-the-scenes footage of 3D animation software in use, showcasing character rigging, lighting, and special effects. The final scene shows an animated dog character celebrating with a checklist.

scenes.action: The video starts with a black screen displaying the Blender logo, indicating the software used for animation.
scenes.camera: Static shot focusing on the logo.

scenes.action: The title 'WING IT! a Pet Project' appears over a blueprint-style background featuring a drawing of a vehicle.
scenes.camera: Static shot showcasing the title and blueprint.

scenes.action: A cat engineer is seen working on various components of a plane inside a cluttered workshop filled with tools and machinery.
scenes.camera: Close-up shots of hands working followed by wider shots showing the cat interacting with controls.

scenes.action: The cat continues working at the control panel, adjusting dials and levers while looking focused.
scenes.camera: Medium shots capturing the cat's expressions and actions at the control panel.

scenes.action: The camera pans out to reveal a large, makeshift airplane sitting inside a barn surrounded by hay bales and chickens.
scenes.camera: Wide shot revealing the entire setup within the barn.

scenes.action: The cat engineer exits the barn wearing an orange spacesuit, appearing excited and ready for flight.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot following the cat as it moves towards the door.

scenes.action: The scene opens with a close-up of a hand holding a yellow pencil checking boxes on a red clipboard. The list contains sketches of a vehicle and symbols. The camera pulls back to reveal a grey cat wearing aviator goggles and a blue jumpsuit. He looks satisfied, then his eyes widen in shock as he hears a noise.
scenes.camera: Close-up on clipboard, then zooms out to medium shot of the cat.

scenes.action: The view shifts to a circular porthole on a heavy metal door. A brown dog with long blue floppy ears presses its face against the glass, smiling widely. Inside, the grey cat cowers in fear, trembling as the dog knocks on the door.
scenes.camera: Static shot of the door, then cuts to the cat's reaction.

scenes.action: The camera pans across the empty, complex control panel filled with levers, buttons, and hanging toys. The dog bursts through the door, floating in zero gravity or moving energetically into the room. The cat hides behind the door frame, peeking out nervously.
scenes.camera: Pan across controls, then wide shot of the entrance.

scenes.action: The dog floats over to the pilot's chair and sits down enthusiastically. It begins frantically pressing buttons and pulling levers all over the console, laughing and waving its arms. The cockpit lights flash.
scenes.camera: Medium shot focusing on the dog's actions at the console.

scenes.action: Outside the vehicle, which resembles a makeshift plane in a barn, various mechanical arms deploy from hatches. One holds a trumpet, another a fan, and stairs extend downwards. A chicken is seen nearby. Inside, the cat runs toward the door as the vehicle shakes violently.
scenes.camera: Cut to exterior showing mechanical deployment, then back to interior action.

scenes.action: The grey cat, wearing a blue flight suit and goggles, stumbles through a doorway into the cockpit. He looks distressed and disoriented. The camera cuts to a close-up of his wide, panicked eyes.
scenes.camera: Medium shot follows the cat, then cuts to a close-up of his face.

scenes.action: The scene shifts to the brown dog, who is sitting in the pilot's chair, laughing maniacally while pressing buttons on the control panel. A large red button pops up, and the dog eagerly prepares to press it.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the cockpit, then zooms in on the dog and the red button.

scenes.action: The grey cat rushes into the frame, screaming in terror as he sees the dog about to press the button. He grabs the dog's arm just in time, preventing him from hitting it. The dog looks confused.
scenes.camera: Quick pan to follow the cat, then a medium shot of the interaction.

scenes.action: The cat scolds the dog, pointing a finger at him. The dog slumps over, looking ashamed. The cat then pulls out a clipboard with a checklist, seemingly trying to regain control of the situation.
scenes.camera: Medium shot of the two characters, then a close-up of the cat holding the clipboard.

scenes.action: The cat checks off items on his list, but suddenly the ship lurches violently. Both characters are thrown around the cockpit. The dog runs towards the door, looking back with a worried expression.
scenes.camera: Shaky cam effect to simulate turbulence, followed by a tracking shot of the dog.

scenes.action: The makeshift rocket ship bursts through the roof of a barn, leaving a trail of smoke. It ascends rapidly into the blue sky, with parts falling off. Inside, the cat and dog are flailing helplessly.
scenes.camera: Low angle shot of the barn roof breaking, then tilting up to follow the rocket's ascent.

scenes.action: The rocket is seen launching into the sky, leaving a trail of smoke behind it. The camera follows the rocket as it ascends through the clouds.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot following the rocket's ascent.

scenes.action: Inside the rocket, the dog is strapped into the pilot's seat, looking panicked. The cat, also in a spacesuit, is floating around due to zero gravity, appearing confused and scared.
scenes.camera: Close-up shots of the characters' faces showing their expressions.

scenes.action: The cat struggles to maintain control, pushing buttons and levers frantically. The interior of the rocket is cluttered with various controls and instruments.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shots from behind the cat, focusing on the control panel.

scenes.action: An umbrella deploys from the top of the rocket but fails to stabilize it. The camera cuts back to the interior where the cat continues to struggle.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the rocket with the umbrella deploying, followed by close-ups inside the cockpit.

scenes.action: Both characters are now visible, both looking distressed. The cat is still trying to regain control while the dog watches helplessly.
scenes.camera: Medium shots capturing both characters in the frame.

scenes.action: A chicken suddenly appears outside the window, flapping its wings wildly. It seems to be affected by the same zero-gravity conditions.
scenes.camera: View from inside the rocket looking out at the chicken.

scenes.action: The dog looks increasingly worried as he realizes the situation is out of control. He shrugs in resignation.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the dog’s face, emphasizing his expression.

scenes.action: The dog pilot is thrown around the cockpit as alarms flash red. He frantically tries to stabilize the controls, grabbing levers and pushing buttons with his blue-gloved hands.
scenes.camera: Medium shot of the dog at the console, then close-ups of his hands manipulating the controls.

scenes.action: The camera cuts to the exterior of the airship, which is tumbling through the clouds. Mechanical arms deploy makeshift orange fabric wings.
scenes.camera: Wide shots showing the airship spinning against a backdrop of clouds and ground below.

scenes.action: Inside, the dog pulls two large levers connected by ropes, straining with effort. The cat floats nearby, looking terrified with wide eyes.
scenes.camera: Close-ups of the dog's strained face and the cat's fearful expression.

scenes.action: The airship levels out, now flying with its new wing attachments. It glides smoothly through the blue sky, dodging between large cloud formations.
scenes.camera: Tracking shots following the airship as it maneuvers through the clouds.

scenes.action: The cat looks out the window in shock as the wing mechanism adjusts. The dog turns around, smiling proudly, holding the control ropes in his mouth.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the cat's shocked face, then a medium shot of the dog celebrating.

scenes.action: Inside a chaotic cockpit with exposed wires and broken panels, an orange-suited dog character enthusiastically pulls on control sticks while a blue-suited cat character watches in shock. The dog checks items off a clipboard as the cat looks increasingly distressed. Suddenly, the ship lurches violently.
scenes.camera: Medium shot of characters in cockpit, then cut to exterior view of falling ship, then high-angle shot of ground rushing up.

scenes.action: The shuttle smashes through the barn roof in a cloud of dust and debris. The orange-suited dog emerges from the wreckage, laughing hysterically while holding his clipboard. He checks off another item. The blue-suited cat crawls out, looking furious and covered in dust, and chases the dog around the crashed vehicle.
scenes.camera: Cut to interior of barn with chickens looking up; crash happens off-screen/dust cloud; medium shot of dog emerging; wide shot of chase scene.

scenes.action: An orange dog and a blue cat are seen running around a barn filled with debris from a crashed vehicle. The dog is wearing a blue hat, and the cat has a determined expression. The environment is dusty and cluttered with broken wooden planks and other wreckage.
scenes.camera: Static shot focusing on the characters and the damaged vehicle.

scenes.action: The screen fades to black, and the words 'The End' appear in white text.
scenes.camera: Static shot of the text.

scenes.action: The video shows the process of creating a storyboard in Blender software. A rough sketch of a dog is drawn and animated within the software interface.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: The video displays the animation of an orange dog character inside a cockpit, controlled by a blue cat. The animation is shown alongside the timeline and keyframes in Blender.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: The video shows the creation of a map in Blender, with various terrains and features being modeled and textured.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: The video displays the animation of a blue cat piloting a spacecraft, looking out at the map created earlier.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: The video shows the rigging process for a blue cat character, with various controls and layers being adjusted in Blender.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: The video demonstrates the animation and rigging of an orange dog character, including facial expressions and body movements.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the Blender software interface.

scenes.action: An animated dog character wearing an orange spacesuit is shown within a 3D modeling software interface. The character's expression changes from neutral to excited with its tongue out. On-screen text lists Sound Design credits: Sander Houtman, Cristo Pruppers, Victor Shcheglov, Danylo Babiak, Eduard Zemlianoi, and Alex Bevz.
scenes.camera: Static view of the software interface, zooming out slightly.

scenes.action: The view switches to show various aspects of the animation pipeline. A rocket engine effect is created using geometry nodes. Then, a smoke puff simulation is adjusted. Finally, a smoke trail effect is manipulated on a flying object. On-screen text lists the Blender Studio Art Team members and their roles, including Andy Goralczyk, Beau Gerbrands, Demeter Dzadik, Hjalti Hjálmarsson, Julien Kaspar, Mack Bo Ross, Nick Alberelli, Pablo Fournier, Rik Schutte, Sebastian Parborg, Simon Thommes, and Vivien Lulkowski.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the software interface, showing different panels and tools.

scenes.action: The screen shows the creation of a smoke trail effect following a small aircraft inside a barn-like structure. On-screen text lists 'Software and Pipeline' contributors: Bastien Montagne, Brecht Van Lommel, Campbell Barton, Clément Foucault, Dalai Felinto, Falk David, Hans Goudey, Jacques Lucke, Jeroen Bakker, Julian Eisel, Lukas Tönne, Nathan Vegdahl, Sergey Sharybin, Sybren Stüvel, and Weizhen Huang.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the software interface.

scenes.action: A grey cat character wearing a blue flight suit and goggles is shown in a distressed state inside a cockpit. The user adjusts cell shading parameters in the properties panel. On-screen text continues to list 'Software and Pipeline' contributors.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the cat character within the software viewport.

scenes.action: The view shifts to show lighting setup on various objects, including lightbulbs and a dashboard button. On-screen text lists 'Blender Staff' members: Anja Vugts-Verstappen, Arnd Marijnissen, Danny McGrath, Haru Legouge, Maaike Kleverlaan, Martha Ligia Salinas, Pablo Vazquez, Trisha Partogi, and 'Production Babies': Anna Schutte and Theo Hjaltason.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the software interface, focusing on lighting and curve editing tools.

scenes.action: The animated dog character is shown crashing into a pile of hay, with hay pieces flying around it. The user adjusts particle physics settings. The scene then transitions to the dog happily holding a clipboard with a checklist, marking items off. On-screen text gives 'Special thanks to the BLENDER STUDIO subscribers', states that 'WING IT!' is an Open Movie, and provides the website studio.blender.org for source files.
scenes.camera: Screen recording of the software interface, showing the character animation and particle effects.

scenes.action: The screen fades to black. White text appears stating 'Licensed as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 © Blender Foundation - studio.blender.org/wing-it'.
scenes.camera: Static shot of the text on a black background.

key_moments.what: The rocket launches out of the barn.
key_moments.why_it_matters: This marks the transition from the internal chaos to the external adventure.
Sets up the chaotic tone for the rest of the clip.
Adds comedic element and highlights lack of proper equipment.
Introduces unexpected humor and further complicates the scenario.
The turning point where the failing ship attempts to stabilize itself.
The successful outcome of the pilot's efforts.

key_moments.what: The dog character's manic laughter and the ship's violent lurch indicate loss of control.
key_moments.why_it_matters: Signals the transition from chaos to disaster.

key_moments.what: The shuttle crashes through the barn roof.
The dog laughs and checks off his list after the crash.
